overview_description.description:
Public is the investing platform built for those who take it seriously—with technology that makes building a multi-asset portfolio, fast, frictionless, and secure.

Members can invest in stocks, options, bonds, crypto, and contribute to retirement accounts —in the same place. Alongside the robust suite of investing tools, Public offers Alpha, a proprietary AI layer, that provides fundamental data and custom analysis to support informed investment decisions.

about_short_description.short_description: Public is a fintech brokerage firm that offers commission-free trading for a variety of asset classes.

product.name: Public Multi-Asset Brokerage Platform
product.description: A self-directed brokerage platform for investing in stocks, ETFs, bonds, treasuries, options, and cryptocurrency, with fractional investing and portfolio management tools.

product.name: Options Trading
product.description: A brokerage service for trading stock, ETF, and index options, including single-leg and multi-leg strategies and volume-based rebates on eligible contracts.

product.name: Fixed-Income Investing
product.description: Access to corporate bonds, fractional bonds, and U.S. Treasury securities, with tools for screening bonds and constructing Treasury allocations.

product.name: Crypto Investing
product.description: A digital-asset trading service that lets users buy, sell, and hold a selection of cryptocurrencies within the Public platform.

product.name: Public Trading API
product.description: An API for programmatic access to account data, market data, order placement, and automated trading across equities, ETFs, options, bonds, and crypto.

product.name: AI Agents
product.description: A natural-language automation service that lets users define rules for monitoring markets, managing cash, and executing recurring trades across stocks, options, and crypto.
